'''Dr Roofoo More Dangerous Than I Realize (DBO)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dr Roofoo]]
* '''Published:''' 18 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif|label=Dantooine Base Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dantooine Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Dantooine Base Operations Roofoo.txt |Download]]

Like a good fight?

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Ok, this is DBO for the sake of force drain denial. The point of the deck, is to null force drains, while still providing a way to inflict damage.

Turn 1)
Hopefully, you will have some locations/mindful of the futures in your hand. If they are playing Watto, pull the desert, and drop sandwhirl, to make them play an early control, or sacrifice poor watto to the sand. Otherwise, pull the Dagobah system, use it to pull the hutt, and get yourself some activaction, baby.
Also, pull the <>farm, or the forest, if you can't find/drew the farm. This should set you up well for activation next turn. If you drew Kessel, don't deploy it, unless you REALLY need the 1 force.

From then on, Projection sites w/ two of your icons, work for a quick flip, and get pull and deploy an x-wing squad to space. using s-foils, and organized assault, you should be able to get a bit of bang out of those squads.

the draws in this deck are good, so use the mains w/ weapons to your advantage. also, don't let chewbacca stay out on the table, unless you NEED him there, he's much more effective as a hit and let die card.

*edited out the weapon levitations, added jedi's resilliance, and mantellian savrip

and... the drains CAN be modified against
ds lsc. -1 b/c of dantooine base, -1 b/c of projection, bonuses canceled w/menace fades
